description: Read one person's public professional profile, fetched FRESH at request time (never from a stored cache). Costs $0.0012 per live read, drawn from your balance; a profile that cannot be read is free. Pass a public identifier or profile address as `profile_ref`, OR the `person_ref` another read returned (a reactor, commenter or search result without a public identifier). Give exactly one. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

person_ref.description: The person_ref another read returned for this person (post_engagers, people_search).

profile_ref.description: A person's public identifier or profile address.

name: people_profile
